description: This Java class 'ErrorHandler' provides centralized exception handling for the Fineract project, mapping various runtime exceptions to appropriate error responses and error info objects, with support for custom exception mappers and specific database error handling.

classes.name: ErrorHandler
classes.description: A final class providing exception handling logic for mapping exceptions to error responses, with support for specific database error codes and custom exception mappers.

methods.name: findMostSpecificExceptionHandler
methods.description: Finds the most specific exception mapper for a given exception, checking registered beans and falling back to a default mapper.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Generates an ErrorInfo object based on the exception, including response status, error code, and message.

methods.name: getMappable
methods.description: Converts a Throwable into a RuntimeException suitable for mapping, with optional custom message code and default message.

methods.name: findMostSpecificException
methods.description: Traverses the cause chain of an exception to find the most specific underlying cause.
